actions.name: Whip Mode
actions.description: As a move action, the mech reconfigures the swordwhip from a solid blade into a fiery, shearing lash for 1 round. In this form, the swordwhip gains the reach and trip special weapon properties, the burn critical hit effect, and deals a combination of fire and slashing damage.

description.value:
A segmented blade that can transform between sword and whip modes.

Special: Whip Mode (1 PP) - Transform the weapon to gain reach for 1 round.
